mapping.summary: Automatic emailing of invoices and documents with templates
claims: Sends documents to customers and suppliers on manual and process-based generation
Invoices sent as PDF by e-mail with related receipts attached to credit notes or reminders
Order confirmations combined with other documents
Recipient and sender taken automatically from the document
Multilingual templates using the document's language
Mail body editor with field placeholders from BC
Central quick parts for reusable attachments
Automatic shipment notifications with tracking link via Comsol Multiship
Flexible sender: document owner, process-related or separate mailbox
12-month minimum term, billed annually in advance
